column1: # The benchmark corpus: public repositories, pinned to exact commits.
# Pinned, not tracked, and deliberately so. An unpinned corpus makes the
# committed results rot the moment upstream moves, and a number nobody can
# reproduce is worth less than no number at all. Re-pinning is a deliberate
# commit that re-runs the harness and moves the results with it.
# One well-known repository per supported language, plus a second Go one
# because Go is the newest extractor and the spread between its best and worst
# case is the honest thing to show. JavaScript is represented by preact, which
# is modern ESM; `expressjs/express` is the other shape of JavaScript and scores
# far worse, for a reason recorded in the README under prototype assignment.
